# LFK Solutions, LLC

> Licensed Master Plumber and general contractor serving Stafford, Virginia and
> the wider DMV (Washington DC, Virginia, Maryland). Residential and commercial
> plumbing, backflow prevention and testing, water heaters, and bathroom, kitchen
> and whole-home remodeling. Established 2015. Bonded and insured.

This file exists so AI answer engines can read an accurate, structured summary of
the business without executing JavaScript. The audit recorded /llms.txt as a 404
on the previous site.

## Credentials

- Master plumbing licenses held in Washington DC, Maryland and Virginia
- Full liability and bonding insurance for commercial and residential work
- Operating since 2015

## Services

- Residential plumbing — repairs, installations, fixtures, repiping
- Commercial plumbing — for commercial properties and property managers
- Backflow prevention and testing
- Water heater installation and repair
- Bathroom remodeling
- Kitchen remodeling
- Home additions and renovations
- Emergency plumbing repairs — burst pipes, major leaks, severe blockages

## Service area

Stafford VA, Fredericksburg VA, Woodbridge VA, Arlington VA, Alexandria VA,
Fairfax VA, Washington DC, Montgomery County MD, Prince George's County MD.
